sources.snippet: Cochlea-SynapSeg 0.1.1 The latest updates to Cochlea-SynapSeg, a Napari plugin for segmenting cochlear ribbon synapses in 3D fluorescence image stacks. SynapSeg provides tools for pre-processing, ground truth annotation, deep learning-based prediction, and post-analysis of synapse pairings.
